paper_metadata.title: Falcon-H1R: Pushing the Reasoning Frontiers with a Hybrid Model for Efficient Test-Time Scaling
paper_metadata.abstract: This work introduces Falcon-H1R, a 7B-parameter reasoning-optimized model that establishes the feasibility of achieving competitive reasoning performance with small language models (SLMs). Falcon-H1R stands out for its parameter efficiency, consistently matching or outperforming SOTA reasoning models that are $2\times$ to $7\times$ larger across a variety of reasoning-intensive benchmarks. These results underscore the importance of careful data curation and targeted training strategies (via both efficient SFT and RL scaling) in delivering significant performance gains without increasing model size. Furthermore, Falcon-H1R advances the 3D limits of reasoning efficiency by combining faster inference (through its hybrid-parallel architecture design), token efficiency, and higher accuracy. This unique blend makes Falcon-H1R-7B a practical backbone for scaling advanced reasoning systems, particularly in scenarios requiring extensive chain-of-thoughts generation and parallel test-time scaling. Leveraging the recently introduced DeepConf approach, Falcon-H1R achieves state-of-the-art test-time scaling efficiency, offering substantial improvements in both accuracy and computational cost. As a result, Falcon-H1R demonstrates that compact models, through targeted model training and architectural choices, can deliver robust and scalable reasoning performance.

extraction_data.innovation: Hybrid Transformer-SSM architecture combining attention and state-space models for efficient long-context reasoning; RL data filtering pipeline using majority vote and pass-rate thresholds to curate high-quality reasoning trajectories for test-time scaling.
extraction_data.finetuning_task: Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT) on high-quality instruction data; Reinforcement Learning (RL) for fine-grained alignment, Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT) for reasoning
extraction_data.extension: Hybrid-parallel architecture design for faster inference; DeepConf approach for test-time scaling efficiency
extraction_data.research_problem: Efficient test-time scaling and reasoning performance in small language models
extraction_data.application: Reasoning-intensive tasks, chain-of-thoughts generation, parallel test-time scaling, mathematics, code generation, multi-hop and scientific reasoning
extraction_data.paper_title: Falcon-H1R: Pushing the Reasoning Frontiers with a Hybrid Model for Efficient Test-Time Scaling
extraction_data.finetuning_data: High-quality instruction data; RL data, Mathematics, coding (Python, C++), science, instruction-following, tool-calling, general chat
extraction_data.hardware_description: 256 H100 GPUs with Fully Sharded Data Parallelism (FSDP) and Context Parallelism (CP=2)
extraction_data.attention_mechanism: Hybrid Transformer–Mamba (state-space), Hybrid Transformer and State Space Model (SSM); Grouped-Query Attention (GQA) with 12 query / 2 key-value heads
extraction_data.training_pipeline: Cold-start SFT Stage -> Reinforcement Learning Stage
extraction_data.reward_mechanism: Verifiable rewards (rule-based checker for math; curated and generated test cases for coding), Binary reward based on correct final extractable answer; two-tier verification using LaTeX string matching and symbolic equivalence checks
extraction_data.training_environment_scale: Distributed sandbox instances via Docker, parallel vLLM instances
extraction_data.safety_evaluation_protocol: Multi-pronged strategy evaluating CoT Only, Answer Only, and CoT+Answer across 81,970 prompts from JailbreakBench, ALERT, AllenAI, WalledEval, and SALAD Bench; safety scores assigned using meta-llama/Llama-Guard-3-8B classifier.
extraction_data.optimizer_innovation: Modified GRPO: clip high, no KL-penalty, no entropy terms, Truncated Importance Sampling, CrossEntropyLoss on positive samples, Online Sampling with backfill and generation caching
extraction_data.benchmark_result: AIME24: 88.1%; AIME25: 83.1%; HMMT25: 64.9%; AMO-Bench: 36.3%; LiveCodeBenchv6: 68.6%; AIME25 (with TTS): 96.7%
extraction_data.post_training_infrastructure: Liger Kernels for fused RoPE, RMSNorm, and Cross-Entropy; streaming-dataset implementation with weighted data-mixture support
